note: Wooded campground at the base of Mount Ascutney, off Route 44A near I-91 exit 8; the 3.7-mile Mount Ascutney Parkway (a separate auto road) climbs to a summit parking lot. Site choice matters for a 23-ft rig: only seven RV sites are longer than 20 ft. Recent ash-tree removal has opened up parts of the forest. --Claude
summary: Park page + 2025 Map & Guide + RA: 38 tent/RV sites (19 RV, 19 tent-only; stored 49 counted lean-tos/cabins), max 34 ft (site 5), six more at 28 ft; no hookups; dump, pay showers, drinking water.
